title: 第一卷 第13章 爷累了你去上面第一卷 第14章 温泉中的师姐
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
在这之后，叶云与雪岚两人，都互相立誓保证不会外传今日之事。
后面叶云离开之时，雪岚则给了她一块令牌作为信物，等到三天之后，带着它就能畅通无阻地登上玉女峰。
不久后，当院外等候的灵烟看到叶云离开，不由问道。
“怎么样，你们谈妥了吗？”
“嗯，谈的很愉快。”
说完，叶云便笑着离开了。
灵烟不明所以，但看到后面的雪岚，连忙上前问道。
“师姐！情况怎么样，达成交易了吗？！”
“自然是达成了。”
见雪岚神色轻松，明显是拿到了丹药。
“那家伙，还蛮厉害嘛。”
灵烟吃了一惊，旋即好奇问道。
“话说回来，他开了什么条件？”
提及此事，雪岚脸上闪过一抹绯红，旋即淡淡道。
“没什么，就只是些寻常之物。”
眼看灵烟还想问，她轻咳一声道。
“好了，我这要先闭关几日，你就先回去吧，这次我欠你个人情，有机会一定还回去。”
“没关系，那师姐您先去解毒吧。”
灵烟连连点头，也没多想。

可在离开之后，越想越觉得不太对劲。
不知为何，总觉得今天师姐说话怪怪的，另外在刚刚，她走路也都有点不太利索。
更关键的是，自己出来时她穿的白衣，刚刚却换成青色长裙，实在是有点不太正常。
种种迹象表明，真相只有一个！
“没错了，那家伙一定把师姐……身上的寒毒给逼了出来！”
反正咱也不知道，她是如何推理出的这一切。
总之在灵烟眼中，闪烁着智慧的光芒，认为自己猜得十分正确！
“哼哼，我果然机智的一批！”
毕竟总不可能说，那两位就跟自己隔着一面墙，然后在闺房之中颠鸾倒凤吧……
……
回到废丹房的叶云，如今一心只想赶快变强。
于是在重塑了一炉聚气丹后，直接就投入热火朝天的修炼之中。
并最终在三天后，以五颗聚气丹为代价，顺利突破瓶颈来到凝气六重之境！
“我这修炼天赋，还真是绝了……”

After that, Ye Yun and Xue Lan both swore to each other that they would not tell anyone what happened today.
When Ye Yun left later, Xue Lan gave her a token as a token. Three days later, with it, she could climb Jade Girl Peak unimpeded.
Soon after, Ling Yan, who was waiting outside the hospital, saw Ye Yun leaving and couldn't help but ask.
"How's it going? Have you reached an agreement?"
"Well, we had a nice conversation."
After saying that, Ye Yun left with a smile.
Ling Yan didn't know why, but when he saw Xue Lan behind him, he quickly stepped forward and asked.
"Senior sister! How is the situation? Has the deal been reached?!"
"Of course it was achieved."
Seeing that Xue Lan looked relaxed, it was obvious that she had obtained the elixir.
"That guy is quite powerful."
Lingyan was taken aback and asked curiously.
"By the way, what conditions did he impose?"
Mentioning this matter, a blush flashed across Xue Lan's face, and she said calmly.
"Nothing, just ordinary things."
Seeing that Ling Yan still wanted to ask, she coughed lightly.
"Okay, I'm going to be in seclusion for a few days, so you can go back first. I owe you a favor this time, and I will definitely return it when I have the chance."
"It doesn't matter. Then senior sister, you can detoxify it first."
Ling Yan nodded repeatedly without thinking much.
But after leaving, the more I thought about it, the more I felt something was not right.
For some reason, I always felt that my senior sister was speaking strangely today, and just now, she was walking a little awkwardly.
What's more important is that the white clothes she was wearing when she came out were changed into a cyan dress just now, which is really a bit abnormal.
There are various signs that there is only one truth!
"That's right, that guy must have forced the cold poison out of Senior Sister...'s body!"
Anyway, we don’t know how she reasoned all this.
In short, the light of wisdom shone in Lingyan's eyes, thinking that his guess was very correct!
"Hmph, I am indeed a smart one!"
After all, it is impossible to say that those two people are separated from me by a wall and then fall in love in the boudoir...
…
Ye Yun, who returned to the Waste Pill Room, now only wants to become stronger as soon as possible.
So after reshaping a furnace of Qi Gathering Pills, he immediately plunged into the intense practice.
And finally, three days later, at the cost of five Qi Gathering Pills, he successfully broke through the bottleneck and reached the sixth level of Qi Condensation!
"My cultivation talent is really amazing..."
